what: The rollout loop's runs (Stu). Generated by make_runs.py from the job files; see DASHBOARD.md.

rungs.stu: Stu's own stages: search at the lead and tricks 1 to 2, blend at trust 0.25 at tricks 3 to 6, rollouts alone from trick 7
rungs.b50: the blend at tricks 3 to 6 at trust 0.5
rungs.pure: the net's opening lead, rollouts alone from the second card on; no double dummy
rungs.pure-sl: pure with a searched opening lead: the search decides the lead, rollouts alone from the second card on
rungs.pure-rl: pure with the opening lead from rollouts: every distinct lead on 512 layouts of the three hidden hands, none dropped; rollouts alone from the second card on
rungs.pure-rs: pure with the opening lead from rollouts on the settings of every other card (at most 4 candidates by the net's prior, 32 then up to 128 layouts with the race); rollouts alone from the second card on
rungs.pure-rs-t: pure-rs with the round's net at the table too (candidates, reading the play) in place of policy v4.1
rungs.pure-rs-p2: pure-rs, the simulated seats drawing from the probabilities squared (power 2)
rungs.pure-rs-top: pure-rs, the simulated seats playing the net's most probable card
rungs.pure-rs-split: pure-rs, the simulated seats split by side: its own side drawn among the cards at least half as likely as the likeliest, the other side among those at least a quarter as likely
rungs.pure-rs-t-imps: pure-rs-t with the rollouts choosing by IMPs in place of mean tricks
rungs.pure-blind-rs: pure-rs, told nothing about who sits against it
rungs.pure-blind-t: pure-rs-t (the round's net at the table too), told nothing about who sits against it
rungs.pure-rs-mix: pure-rs, playing a random one of its candidates within 0.05 tricks of the best, defending too
rungs.pure-blind: pure (the net's lead), told nothing about who sits against it: the simulated opponents are the net's unknown player, their cards read at the weight of an opponent never met and as a side that may play any equal card
rungs.pure-blind-split: pure, told nothing about who sits against it, the simulated seats split by side, its defenders playing a random one of their equal cards
rungs.net-d: the net alone, every card drawn from its probabilities (as a simulated seat of the rollouts draws)
rungs.net-s: the net alone, a longer-trained variant of the round's net (the epoch best on pure Stu's held-out cards within a limit on forgetting)
rungs.pure-t: pure, with the rollout net at the table as well (its lead, first choices and reading of the play) in place of policy v4.1
rungs.pure-v: pure, the rollouts' simulated seats playing by the net's value head (seat blend) in place of a draw from its probabilities
rungs.net: the net alone: its first card at every trick; no search, no rollouts, no claims, no mixing

A collection run's first_bot.rung says which bot plays it, and tables_a_board 1 that its rows carry no IMPs.
